landforms.note: The Pleasure Dome of the Bay's island in Erehwon's bay: the Erewhon page's island (settlements/xanadu, target erewhon, ISLAND_C at 70,-613 m from the page's centre, which stands on Erehwon's pin 805,1516 unturned), about 220 x 110 m and 14 m over the lake, some 150 m off the world's shore (the owner, 2026-11-11: keep the page, move the record; it stays off the quays, about 0.6 km). No shoal: its rounded cell is the shore bench. Stamped at 1:1 by openworld/xanadu-oidong-highrift/src/44-world-landforms.js. edit_517 (first run as edit_512 on claude/openworld-sites, 2026-11-11).
A basalt stack off the lake's west shore, 42 m over the water. Sub-cell; its cell's bed held as a shoal. edit_517, 2026-11-11.

Phēr's headland (the owner, 2026-11-16: "give it a headland and cove"): the arm from the shore's bend west of the town, its rise joining the bench; the cove lies east of it. settlements/pher/PLAN.md section 1.2, edit_517_pher.py.

Phēr's headland (the owner, 2026-11-16: "give it a headland and cove"): the arm from the shore's bend west of the town, its rise joining the bench; the cove lies east of it. settlements/pher/PLAN.md section 1.2, edit_517_pher.py.
The low point east of Phēr's cove, closing it to about 1 km across. settlements/pher/PLAN.md section 1.2, edit_517_pher.py.

Voth's page's water on the model: the union of these circles and capsules, blended by a smooth minimum of 210 m, with ~116 m of noise on the shore on the page (landDist). The page's x is east and z south, its origin Voth's pin; 22 km2 of water, the shore 20.4 km. edit_513, 2026-11-11 (openworld/PLAN-VOTH.md V1).
The narrows between Voth's bay and its lake, 1.1 km wide (the Fortress canton stands in it). edit_513, 2026-11-11 (openworld/PLAN-VOTH.md V1).

Voth's strait from the lake north-north-east to the Ring Sea, 680 m wide on the page; the model carries it as a chain of wet cells (2 km), so the stamp narrows it. edit_513, 2026-11-11 (openworld/PLAN-VOTH.md V1).

A shelf 1.2-4.8 m deep for the first 70 m off every shore of Voth's water (the chinampas and the canton ring need it), then the page's bed: 13.8 m at 330 m, 36.8 m at 920 m, 51.8 m at 2.1 km off the shore. edit_513, 2026-11-11 (openworld/PLAN-VOTH.md V1).

The Turm's last 5.3 km on Voth's page, mouth first (the bay's south-east corner): at the lake's level the whole way, 80-170 m wide on a flat floodplain; the bridges, docks, the river port and the River Gate stand on it. edit_513, 2026-11-11 (openworld/PLAN-VOTH.md V1).
An islet in Voth's water (shrine), 16 m over it. Sub-cell; its cell keeps the page's bed. edit_513, 2026-11-11 (openworld/PLAN-VOTH.md V1).
